scope: Person C (ML Specialist) - Energy ML & Person A Backend Telemetry Compatibility Audit

station_id_mismatch_analysis.mtr_notes: Both Person C and Person A use 'MTR' for Maitri Station.
station_id_mismatch_analysis.brt_vs_bhr_notes: Person C canonical code for Bharati is 'BRT' across all datasets, models, and contracts. Person A's backend contains legacy/transitional references to 'BHR'. Person A must align backend station identifiers to canonical 'BRT' or establish an explicit gateway ingestion normalization. Person C ML strictly enforces 'BRT' and rejects unrecognized strings without silent aliasing.

raw_telemetry_fields.timestamp_semantics: Instantaneous observation timestamp at decision epoch t
raw_telemetry_fields.required_person_a_action: Ensure all timestamps are serialized as valid ISO-8601 UTC strings or standard RFC 3339 format.
raw_telemetry_fields.notes: Hourly cadence is expected for multi-horizon forecasting.

raw_telemetry_fields.source: Station metadata / MQTT topic / REST payload
raw_telemetry_fields.required_person_a_action: Standardize Bharati station code to 'BRT' in telemetry ingestion pipelines. Person C rejects 'BHR' with ValueError to prevent silent model misclassification.
raw_telemetry_fields.notes: MTR = Maitri Station (120 kW rated generator); BRT = Bharati Station (150 kW rated generator).

raw_telemetry_fields.timestamp_semantics: Instantaneous total station electrical & thermal load at time t
raw_telemetry_fields.required_person_a_action: None. Provide aggregate power demand in kW.
raw_telemetry_fields.notes: Valid range: 0.0 to 300.0 kW. Used directly as core LSTM input and base for rolling mean/slope.

raw_telemetry_fields.timestamp_semantics: Instantaneous active diesel generator electrical output at time t
raw_telemetry_fields.required_person_a_action: None. Provide active generator output in kW.
raw_telemetry_fields.notes: Valid range: 0.0 to 300.0 kW. Used for generator utilization and spinning reserve monitoring.

raw_telemetry_fields.timestamp_semantics: Instantaneous BESS State-of-Charge at time t
raw_telemetry_fields.notes: Valid range: 0.0 to 100.0%. Critical for deficit-risk thresholding (SoC < 25%).

raw_telemetry_fields.timestamp_semantics: Instantaneous battery charging power at time t
raw_telemetry_fields.required_person_a_action: None. Provide charging power in kW (non-negative).
raw_telemetry_fields.notes: Valid range: 0.0 to 100.0 kW. Non-negative. Mutually exclusive with discharge.

raw_telemetry_fields.timestamp_semantics: Instantaneous battery discharging power at time t
raw_telemetry_fields.required_person_a_action: None. Provide discharging power in kW (non-negative).
raw_telemetry_fields.notes: Valid range: 0.0 to 100.0 kW. Non-negative. Mutually exclusive with charge.

raw_telemetry_fields.timestamp_semantics: Hourly rate of diesel fuel consumption at time t
raw_telemetry_fields.required_person_a_action: None. Provide fuel burn rate in Liters/hour.

raw_telemetry_fields.timestamp_semantics: Ambient outdoor air temperature at time t
raw_telemetry_fields.source: AWS Weather Station / NCPOR archives / simulator
raw_telemetry_fields.required_person_a_action: None. Provide ambient temperature in degrees Celsius.
raw_telemetry_fields.notes: Valid range: -65.0 to +25.0 °C. Strongly correlated with HVAC heating demand.

raw_telemetry_fields.timestamp_semantics: Ambient relative humidity at time t
raw_telemetry_fields.source: AWS Weather Station / NCPOR archives / simulator
raw_telemetry_fields.required_person_a_action: None. Provide relative humidity as percentage [0.0, 100.0].

raw_telemetry_fields.timestamp_semantics: Barometric surface air pressure at time t
raw_telemetry_fields.source: AWS Weather Station / NCPOR archives / simulator
raw_telemetry_fields.required_person_a_action: None. Provide surface atmospheric pressure in hPa.

raw_telemetry_fields.timestamp_semantics: Sustained wind speed at time t
raw_telemetry_fields.required_person_a_action: None. Provide wind speed in meters per second.
raw_telemetry_fields.notes: Valid range: 0.0 to 80.0 m/s. Triggers blizzard trace heating load.

raw_telemetry_fields.timestamp_semantics: Upstream Sensor ML composite reconstruction error / anomaly score at time t
raw_telemetry_fields.required_person_a_action: Pass upstream Sensor ML anomaly score if available; otherwise defaults cleanly to 1.0 (nominal).
raw_telemetry_fields.notes: Defaults to 1.0 if omitted by backend.

raw_telemetry_fields.timestamp_semantics: Upstream Sensor ML operational health decision at time t
raw_telemetry_fields.required_person_a_action: Pass upstream Sensor ML status string if available; otherwise defaults cleanly to 'NORMAL'.
raw_telemetry_fields.notes: Defaults to 'NORMAL' if omitted. Backend must NOT independently reinterpret anomaly status.

raw_telemetry_fields.timestamp_semantics: Telemetry acquisition quality flag at time t
raw_telemetry_fields.required_person_a_action: Pass 'GOOD' or 'MISSING' if known; otherwise defaults cleanly to 'GOOD'.

blocking_issues.description: Station ID mismatch between Person C canonical 'BRT' and Person A references to 'BHR'. Person A must standardize ingestion to 'BRT' before running integrated dispatch.

non_blocking_issues.description: 24-hour historical window buffering required in backend before multi-horizon neural forecasting is active (service raises explicit ValueError if < 24h).
Upstream Sensor ML anomaly features are optional but recommended for microgrid health context.
